title: Sokoban: how to play
sections: Push every crate onto a target spot. The level is done when all crates sit on targets.
You can push one crate at a time by walking into it, but you can never pull a crate, and you can't push two crates in a row or push a crate into a wall.

Swipe to take one step in that direction (pushing a crate if one is there). Tap a free square to walk there by the shortest way. Undo takes back a step, Restart starts the level again, Skip level gives you a new one.

Never push a crate into a corner that isn't a target: it can't come out again. The same goes for a crate pushed against a wall unless there is a target along that wall. Think about the order: fill the targets furthest from the start first. Every level can be solved.
Easy levels have 2 crates, Normal 3 and Hard 4, and from level 11 one more. The rooms grow a little every 5 levels. Your level is remembered.
